svg.title: Forged records caught: 150 of 150 with the signature check
svg.desc: Of 150 forged copies, the signature check caught all 150. A check that only reads the format caught none of them, because every forged copy was still well-formed.

g.font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: 150 forged copies of 15 signed records, ten kinds of forgery
Check that only reads the format
